matches.title: Maritimo vs Academico Viseu
matches.description: Watch Maritimo vs Academico Viseu highlights and goals from Primeira Liga on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 22, 2026. The Primeira Liga clash on August 22, 2026, between Maritimo and Academico Viseu delivered a high-stakes encounter where momentum shifted unpredictably from start to finish. Both sides looked to impose their will in a contest that kept the fans on the edge of their seats until the final whistle. First Half Dominance by the Visitors Academico Viseu started the match with clinical precision, capitalizing on their opportunities to stun the home crowd. The breakthrough came in the 25th minute when Anthony Correia delivered a perfectly weighted assist for Andre Clovis , who rose highest to head the ball home. Maritimo struggled to find their rhythm in the final third, despite several corner opportunities delivered by Igor Juliao . As the first half drew to a close, things went from bad to worse for the hosts. In the 45th+1 minute, Soufiane Messeguem seized upon a defensive error by Rafael Fernandes to slot the ball home with his right foot. Heading into the break with a two-goal lead, Academico Viseu appeared to be in total command of the proceedings. VAR Intervention and Maritimo's Fightback The second half began with a massive moment of controversy. In the 49th minute, Andre Clovis thought he had extended the lead further, but a VAR review ruled the goal out for offside. This let-off sparked a resurgence from Maritimo , who began to dominate possession and territory. Their persistence finally paid off in the 70th minute when Paulo Henrique found the net with a clinical left-footed strike to make it 1-2. The match grew increasingly physical as both sides battled for control, with the referee busy issuing yellow cards to maintain order. Maritimo manager made several tactical changes, including bringing on Bryan Limbombe , to maintain the pressure as the clock ticked down toward the final ten minutes. Late Penalty Drama and Red Card The defining moment of the comeback arrived in the 84th minute. Andre Ceitil was penalized for tripping Adrian Butzke inside the box, handing Maritimo a golden opportunity from the penalty spot. Butzke stepped up himself in the 88th minute, coolly sending Ewerton the wrong way to equalize and send the home fans into raptures. There was still time for more drama in stoppage time. In the 90th+4 minute, Bruno Pinheiro was shown a straight red card for dissent after verbally abusing the referee. Despite the numerical advantage for the final moments, Maritimo couldn't find a winner, and a pulsating match ended in a hard-fought draw.

matches.title: Academico Viseu vs Santa Clara
matches.description: Watch Academico Viseu vs Santa Clara highlights and goals from Primeira Liga on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 15, 2026. The Primeira Liga delivered a tactical and high-stakes encounter on August 15, 2026 , as Academico Viseu played host to Santa Clara . Both sides took to the pitch with clear ambitions of establishing dominance, setting the stage for a match defined by narrow margins and clinical execution. Paciencia Strikes from the Spot Santa Clara signaled their intent early on, nearly producing a goal of the season contender in the 10th minute. Goncalo Paciencia connected with a stunning bicycle kick that seemed destined for the net, only for Ewerton to produce a brilliant save. However, the pressure told just moments later. In the 12th minute, Ruben Pereira tripped Sorriso inside the penalty area, prompting the referee to point to the spot and issue a yellow card to the Academico Viseu defender. After a brief VAR review confirmed the initial decision, Goncalo Paciencia stepped up in the 14th minute. The striker remained composed, firing a right-footed shot past Ewerton , who came close to a save but couldn't keep it out. The remainder of the first half was a physical affair, highlighted by a yellow card for Sorriso for a shirt-pull, as Santa Clara took their lead into the interval. Tactical Shifts and Penalty Drama Academico Viseu emerged for the second half with renewed vigor, eventually controlling 60% of the ball. Despite their territorial dominance, they struggled to create clear-cut openings against a disciplined Santa Clara defense. Both managers turned to their benches to find a spark; Pedro Barcelos and Nikolaos Michelis were introduced for the hosts, while the visitors looked to consolidate their position with fresh legs. The game's most controversial moment arrived in the 82nd minute. Guilherme Romao went down in the box, sparking appeals for a penalty that could have changed the match. However, the referee ruled that the player had dived, brandishing a yellow card instead and leaving the home fans incensed. A Frantic Finish As the match entered stoppage time, Academico Viseu threw everything forward. In the 95th minute, Robinho delivered a pinpoint cross that found Joao Guilherme , but the resulting header flashed wide of the post. Santa Clara 's backline, anchored by late clearances from Hiago Santos and vital interceptions by Lucas Franca , held firm under intense pressure to secure the three points as the final whistle blew.
